cards.title: Boundary Record
cards.description: Link, corridor, intersection, station, curb zone, district, or metropolitan system.

cards.title: Flow Record
cards.description: Vehicle flows, person flows, freight flows, transit flows, pedestrian flows, and inflow-outflow timing.

cards.title: Capacity Record
cards.description: Physical, operational, institutional, curbside, transit, signal, or service constraints.

cards.title: Behavior Record
cards.description: Route choice, mode choice, departure-time choice, parking behavior, induced demand, and land-use adjustment.

cards.title: Multimodal Record
cards.description: Transit, walking, cycling, ride-hail, freight, curbside, and emergency access assumptions.

cards.title: Equity Record
cards.description: Travel burden, access, exposure, affordability, mode constraints, safety, and neighborhood impacts.

cards.title: Claim Boundary
cards.description: Teaching, operations, scenario comparison, infrastructure planning, or decision support.
